Author: Zhyra
Name: SealHunter
Punchline: Automate your Grand Company hunting log.
Description: Works through the three Grand Company hunting logs for you: teleports to the right zone, walks to each target with vnavmesh, and clears the required marks using BossMod Reborn autorotation. Requires vnavmesh, Lifestream, and BossMod Reborn.
